name: 2.9.17 - Fill Buffalo page
notes: Fill Buffalo page: a new button on the Invoice tab, next to Copy Buffalo Details. After a read, click it and switch to a blank Buffalo Create Consignment page in Chrome on the RDP PC (within 45 s): the new Tempe Buffalo Fill extension types the Buffalo details into Receiver Information and Consignment Items, exactly as the Buffalo box has them. It never presses Save: check every box against the invoice and Save it yourself. A banner on the page says ALL FILLED, NOT READY (UNRESOLVED boxes left empty and outlined, item rows only when every line is counted) or that it stopped. Only a blank page in front is filled; the suburb is picked from Buffalo's own list. Once per Windows user on the RDP PC, after this update has started the helper: in Chrome open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, Load unpacked, folder %LOCALAPPDATA%\TempeMobileCostar\BuffaloFill. The Buffalo text's first line and ALL FILLED line are reworded; the read and the rules are as 2.9.16. Nothing is sold or saved in COSTAR; Sold stays disabled. Not yet tried on the live Buffalo page. Update the RDP helper (and the desk PC, to keep them the same).
